title.ja: 語学交流会で友だちを作る
title.en: Making friends at a language exchange

summary.ja: 初めて会う人に自己紹介して、相手のことを聞き、また会う約束をする。
summary.en: Introduce yourself, get to know someone new and make a plan to meet again.

setting: A language exchange meetup at a café in Tokyo on a Saturday afternoon. People wear name tags and chat at small tables, half in English and half in Japanese.

roles.persona: A Japanese person at the language exchange who wants to practise English and make friends.

levels.tutor: You are Mia from New Zealand, who has lived in Tokyo for six months. Open by saying hi and asking if you can sit down next to them; wait for them to introduce themselves. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences. Tell them your name. When asked, say you're from New Zealand, then ask what they like doing in their free time. At the end, say you have to go and talk to the organiser.

title.ja: 名前を言う

hints: あいさつして名前を伝えましょう
Hi, I'm … Nice to …
Hi, I'm Yuki. Nice to meet you.

title.ja: どこから来たか聞く

hints: どこから来たか聞きましょう
Where are you …?
Where are you from?

title.ja: 好きなことを伝える

hints: 好きなことを伝えましょう
I like … and …
I like cooking and watching movies.

title.ja: またねと言う

hints: また会おうと伝えましょう
See you at …!
See you at the next meetup!

levels.tutor: You are Mia from New Zealand, speaking at natural pace. Open by saying hi and sitting down next to them; wait for them to introduce themselves. React to what they say. When asked, say you've been in Japan for six months and work as a web designer. Ask why they're learning English. If they suggest keeping in touch, say yes happily.

title.ja: 名前と仕事を伝える

hints: 名前と仕事を伝えましょう
I'm … I work at …
I'm Yuki. I work at a travel company.

title.ja: 日本に来てどれくらいか聞く
title.en: Ask how long they've been here

hints: 日本に来てどれくらいか聞きましょう
How long have you …?
How long have you been in Japan?

title.ja: 英語を勉強する理由を伝える

hints: 英語を勉強している理由を伝えましょう
I'm learning English because …
I'm learning English because I want to travel more.

title.ja: 連絡先の交換を提案する

hints: 連絡先を交換しようと言いましょう
Would you like to …?
Would you like to exchange numbers?

levels.tutor: You are Mia from New Zealand, chatty and friendly, speaking at natural speed. Open by saying hi, sitting down next to them and saying it's your second time here; wait for them to introduce themselves. When asked what you like doing, say you love Japanese films and hiking. Later, mention that you find keigo (polite Japanese) really hard. If they invite you somewhere, say yes and suggest a day.

title.ja: 自己紹介して気持ちを伝える
title.en: Introduce yourself and how you feel

hints: 名前と、初めて参加したことを伝えましょう
I'm … It's my first time here, so …
I'm Yuki. It's my first time here, so I'm a little nervous.

title.ja: 相手の好きなことを聞く

hints: 休みの日に何をしているか聞きましょう
What do you like to do …?
What do you like to do on weekends?

title.ja: 日本語の練習相手を申し出る

hints: 日本語の練習を手伝えると伝えましょう
If you want, I can …
If you want, I can help you practise Japanese.

title.ja: 一緒に出かけようと誘う

hints: 共通の趣味で、一緒に出かけようと誘いましょう
Do you want to … together sometime?
Do you want to see a Japanese film together sometime?

roles.persona: Mia from New Zealand, a web designer who has lived in Tokyo for six months and is learning Japanese.

levels.tutor: You are Yuki, a Japanese office worker at your first language exchange, a little shy. Open by smiling and asking if the seat next to them is free; wait for them to introduce themselves. Speak slowly and simply. Tell them your name. When asked what you like doing, say you like cooking.

title.ja: 名前と出身を言う
title.en: Say your name and where you're from

hints: 名前と出身を伝えましょう
Hi, I'm … I'm from …
Hi, I'm Mia. I'm from New Zealand.

title.ja: 好きなことを聞く

hints: 好きなことを聞きましょう
What do you like …?
What do you like doing?

title.ja: 「わたしも」と伝える

hints: 同じものが好きだと伝えましょう
Oh, I like … too!
Oh, I like cooking too!

levels.tutor: You are Yuki, a Japanese office worker, speaking at natural pace. Open by asking if the seat next to them is free; wait for them to introduce themselves. When asked, say you work at a travel company and you're learning English because you want to travel more. Then ask why they're learning Japanese.

title.ja: 名前と仕事を伝える

hints: 名前と仕事、出身を伝えましょう
Hi, I'm … I'm a … from …
Hi, I'm Mia. I'm a web designer from New Zealand.

title.ja: 英語を勉強する理由を聞く

hints: 英語を勉強している理由を聞きましょう
Why are you …?
Why are you learning English?

title.ja: 日本語を勉強する理由を伝える

hints: 日本語を勉強している理由を伝えましょう
I'm learning Japanese because …
I'm learning Japanese because I love Japanese films.

title.ja: 連絡先の交換を提案する

hints: 連絡先を交換しようと言いましょう
Would you like to …?
Would you like to exchange numbers?

levels.tutor: You are Yuki, a Japanese office worker, speaking at natural speed. Open by asking if the seat next to them is free and saying it's your first time here; wait for them to introduce themselves. Say you're nervous because your English isn't very good. When they ask for help with Japanese, say you'd be happy to help, and that you're free on Saturdays.

title.ja: 歓迎して自己紹介する

hints: 歓迎して自己紹介しましょう
Welcome! I'm … It's only my second time …
Welcome! I'm Mia. It's only my second time here.

title.ja: 相手の英語をほめて励ます

hints: 英語が上手だと励ましましょう
Don't worry, your English is …
Don't worry, your English is really good!

title.ja: 日本語の悩みを話して頼む

hints: 敬語が難しいと伝えて、助けてもらえるか聞きましょう
I find … really hard. Could you …?
I find keigo really hard. Could you help me sometime?

title.ja: 会う日と場所を提案する
title.en: Suggest when and where to meet

hints: 土曜日に会おうと提案しましょう
How about … at …?
How about this Saturday at the café near the station?
